description: Calendar Heatmap is a Power BI custom visual for displaying daily values in a familiar calendar layout. Use it to analyze day-level patterns across one or more months with a clean month-by-month heatmap experience. The visual supports report filtering, day and month selection, responsive layout behavior, configurable headers, and color formatting options. Key capabilities include: - Month-by-month calendar heatmap layout - Interactive day and month selection - Cross-filtering with other Power BI visuals - Dynamic day color formatting - Dynamic month card color formatting - Editable title and subtitle - Responsive layout for different report sizes Calendar Heatmap is designed for scenarios such as sales analysis, operations monitoring, attendance tracking, activity reporting, and other daily trend analysis use cases.
